resources.string: Auto Focus for Telegram automatically focuses the message input field and raises the soft keyboard as soon as you open any chat in Telegram.
Last response time: No events yet
Telegram is installed on this device.
Telegram (org.telegram.messenger or Telegram X) is not installed on this device.

Auto Focus for Telegram requires the Accessibility Service permission to observe when you open a chat in Telegram and automatically trigger input field focus and soft keyboard display.\n\nThis app does not read, store, or transmit any message contents or personal data. It only inspects UI layout elements within Telegram to detect chat input fields.
